```sql
WITH star_prairie_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Star Prairie' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Wisconsin'
),
raster_subset AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM star_prairie_geom),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast,
    (SELECT geom FROM star_prairie_geom)
  )
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM raster_subset
)
SELECT
  (ST_DumpAsPolygons(slope_rast)).val AS max_slope_degrees
FROM slope_raster
ORDER BY val DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
